versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the ebook-reader skill.
- Supports parsing and analysis of common ebook formats (EPUB, PDF).
- Provides structured book notes: chapter summaries, key excerpts, in-depth analysis, and actionable application advice.
- Outputs comprehensive full-book analysis and curated further reading recommendations.
- Requires Python dependencies: ebooklib==0.18, pypdf==3.17.0, beautifulsoup4==4.12.0.
